title: Construction Spending Is Not A Commissioned Asset
summary: From expenditure through installed work, inspection, testing, deficiency correction, integrated commissioning, acceptance and service.
map_question: What records are required before construction spending is not a commissioned asset can support a bounded territorial-delivery decision?
interpretation_boundary: A capital plan is not an executable project. A permit is not a construction start. Construction spending is not a commissioned asset. Substantial completion is not safe accessible service. Floor area is not place value. Reconstruction output is not community recovery.

what_this_map_supports: Separate territorial, project, procurement, construction, commissioning, service, stewardship and recovery decisions.
Explicit authority, identities, baselines, dependencies, distribution, alternatives, stress, review and remedy.
Public reasoning without asset, project, contractor, worker, community, place, jurisdiction or country scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not approve land, permits, procurement, construction, commissioning, occupancy, service, maintenance, adaptation or reconstruction.
It does not convert plans, permits, spending, completion, floor area or output totals into outcomes.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance or operating-outcome change.
